rationale: A MenuCommand may now name the application menu instead of a menu-bar submenu, by leaving its menu field empty. One transferred surface is touched and none is added: WindowOptions::MenuCommand keeps its existing fields and gains only a documented meaning for a value it already accepted, so the struct layout and the vtable are unchanged and an SDK subclass keeps its slot layout. Empty was previously a silent drop, so no existing caller changes behaviour. The macOS menu assembly that acts on this lives in macos-shell-deferred, which is not framework-authoritative-transferred, so it is not covered here. This is Pulp-specific standalone-host product work: a single-window app has no reason to own a Window menu holding one toggle, and the feature was undiscoverable because of it. There is no counterpart framework behaviour to backport.
